title: Zero runtime dependencies via stdlib node:sqlite
evidence: src/books.ts:2 imports node:sqlite (DatabaseSync); package.json has no dependencies block, only tsc/tsx/@types/node devDeps
suggestion: None — notable that spec's SQLite requirement is met with the built-in module (Node >=22.5) instead of better-sqlite3

title: Testable factory + 1MB body cap and JSON-parse guard
evidence: src/books.ts:49 createBookServer(databasePath) lets tests use ':memory:'; readBody caps at 1_000_000 bytes (books.ts:23) and rejects non-JSON (books.ts:27)

title: GET /books/0 and non-positive ids fall through to generic 404 'Not found', not 400
evidence: src/books.ts:84 id regex ^/books/([1-9]\d*)$ excludes 0/leading-zero ids, so they miss the /books/{id} branch and return {error:'Not found'} at books.ts:109 instead of a 400 invalid-id
suggestion: Acceptable; if stricter validation is desired, match \d+ and 400 on non-positive ids (the Number.isSafeInteger guard at books.ts:87 is currently unreachable)
